3571: /// A cached shared build: the build, or its non-budget failure with the work
3572: /// it spent (counted again against every case that meets it, so each case's
3573: /// budget decisions equal a separate solve's).
3574: type Slot<S> = Option<Result<Arc<S>, (AttemptStop, u64, StageWork)>>;
3575: 
3576: /// A cached verification shared build, as `Slot`; a failure also keeps the
3577: /// Uc_c refusals recorded before it (RV23-1).
3578: type VerifySlot<S> = Option<Result<Arc<S>, (AttemptStop, u64, StageWork, Vec<BlockRefusal>)>>;
3579: 
3580: /// The shared stages of one stiffness identity, per precision.
3581: #[derive(Debug, Default, Clone)]
3582: pub(crate) struct GroupCache {
3583:     s128: Slot<Shared<4, 4>>,
3584:     s256: Slot<Shared<4, 8>>,
3585:     s512: Slot<Shared<8, 16>>,
3586:     s1024: Slot<Shared<16, 16>>,
3587:     // D1 revision 5a.3: the verification's shared data per precision (q_W =
3588:     // 448, 832 and 1024).
3589:     v256: VerifySlot<VerifyShared<4, 8>>,
3590:     v512: VerifySlot<VerifyShared<8, 16>>,
3591:     v1024: VerifySlot<VerifyShared<16, 16>>,
3592: }

4184: fn finish_selected(
4185:     prep: Arc<CasePrep>,
4186:     group: Arc<GroupPrep>,
4187:     cache: GroupCache,
4188:     states: Vec<PrecisionState>,
4189:     selected: &PrecisionState,
4190:     verification_precision: u32,
4191:     mut attempts: Vec<AttemptRecord>,
4192:     decision: &StopDecision,
4193:     report: &VerificationState,
4194:     certified: CertifiedPublication,
4195:     geometry: Vec<BodyGeometry>,
4196: ) -> CaseOutcome {
4197:     if !Arc::ptr_eq(&prep, &certified.prep) || selected.precision() != certified.precision {
4198:         let stop = certificate_error(None, CertificateIssue::PairIdentity);
4199:         if let Some(record) = attempts
4200:             .iter_mut()
4201:             .find(|a| a.precision == selected.precision() && a.outcome == AttemptOutcome::Accepted)
4202:         {
4203:             record.outcome = AttemptOutcome::Failed(AttemptReason::Stop(stop.clone()));
4204:         }
4205:         return finish_terminal(&stop, attempts, geometry);
4206:     }
4207:     // The certified bytes are moved, never re-rounded/reclassified here.
4208:     let publication = certified.publication;
4209:     let publication_radius_bits = certified.radii;
4210:     let verification = match report.summary() {
4211:         Ok(v) => v,
4212:         Err(stop) => return finish_terminal(&stop, attempts, geometry),
4213:     };
4214:     for (body, bound) in verification.bound.iter().enumerate() {
4215:         if bound.is_some_and(|b| !b.is_finite()) {
4216:             return CaseOutcome::Unresolved {
4217:                 reason: UnresolvedReason::CertifiedBoundUnencodable { body: body as u32 },
4218:                 attempts,
4219:                 geometry,
4220:             };
4221:         }
4222:     }
4223:     let selected_record = attempts
4224:         .iter()
4225:         .find(|a| a.precision == selected.precision() && a.outcome == AttemptOutcome::Accepted)
4226:         .cloned();
4227:     let evidence = RetainedEvidence {
4228:         method: METHOD_TOKEN,
4229:         policy: POLICY,
4230:         selected_precision: selected.precision(),
4231:         verification_precision,
4232:         stop_rule: decision.summary.clone(),
4233:         floor_ratio_bits: FLOOR_RATIO_BITS,
4234:         body_scales: publication.body_scales.clone(),
4235:         input_derived_dofs: prep.source.constraints().iter().map(|c| c.dof).collect(),
4236:         absolute_verified: publication
4237:             .rows
4238:             .iter()
4239:             .filter_map(|r| match r.class {
4240:                 RowClass::AbsoluteVerified { bound_bits } => Some((r.id, bound_bits)),
4241:                 _ => None,
4242:             })
4243:             .collect(),
4244:         not_covered: Vec::new(),
4245:         unpublishable: publication
4246:             .rows
4247:             .iter()
4248:             .filter(|r| r.class == RowClass::Unpublishable)
4249:             .map(|r| (r.id, r.value))
4250:             .collect(),
4251:         pivot_margin_min: selected_record
4252:             .as_ref()
4253:             .and_then(|r| r.pivot_margin_min)
4254:             .unwrap_or(0.0),
4255:         rcond: selected_record
4256:             .as_ref()
4257:             .and_then(|r| r.rcond)
4258:             .unwrap_or(0.0),
4259:         rcond_label: RCOND_LABEL,
4260:         residual_worst: selected_record
4261:             .as_ref()
4262:             .and_then(|r| r.residual_worst)
4263:             .unwrap_or(0.0),
4264:         corrections: selected.corrections(),
4265:         geometry,
4266:         source_encoding: prep.identity.clone(),
4267:         ledger_encoding: prep.ledger.encoding(),
4268:         retained_state_encoding: selected.encoding(),
4269:         attempts,
4270:         resolution_scale: verification
4271:             .resolution
4272:             .iter()
4273:             .enumerate()
4274:             .map(|(b, e)| (b as u32, e[0].to_bits(), e[1].to_bits()))
4275:             .collect(),
4276:         verification_estimate: decision.estimate_summary.clone(),
4277:         verification_charge: decision.charge_summary.clone(),
4278:         theta: verification
4279:             .theta
4280:             .iter()
4281:             .enumerate()
4282:             .map(|(b, t)| (b as u32, *t))
4283:             .collect(),
4284:         certified_bound: verification
4285:             .bound
4286:             .iter()
4287:             .enumerate()
4288:             .filter_map(|(b, v)| v.map(|v| (b as u32, v.to_bits())))
4289:             .collect(),
4290:         floor: decision.floor.as_ref().map(|f| {
4291:             f.iter()
4292:                 .enumerate()
4293:                 .map(|(b, x)| (b as u32, x[0].to_bits(), x[1].to_bits()))
4294:                 .collect()
4295:         }),
4296:     };
4297:     CaseOutcome::Selected(Box::new(RetainedSolve {
4298:         prep,
4299:         group,
4300:         cache,
4301:         states,
4302:         selected: selected.precision(),
4303:         evidence,
4304:         publication,
4305:         publication_radius_bits,
4306:     }))
